item1.question: How do I get started?
item1.answer: To start using Study Studio, simply create a free account and complete your personal profile. Then you can explore features and join classes or study groups.

item2.question: Do I need a subscription?
item2.answer: No, you don't need a mandatory subscription. Study Studio offers a free plan with basic features. If you want access to premium features, you can upgrade to Pro or Premium plans.

item3.question: How do I manage my account?
item3.answer: You can manage your account by going to Settings. There you can update personal information, change password, manage subscriptions, and adjust notification preferences.

item4.question: Are there any limitations for free accounts?
item4.answer: Yes, free accounts have some limitations such as maximum 1GB storage, basic tools, and community support. If you need more resources and support, consider upgrading to our paid plans.
